description: Per-route client JavaScript (gzip) of the starter project (create-nextspark-app --preset saas --theme starter, Cache Components on) built from this repo. maxGzipBytes is the published 0.1.0-beta.193 project (same flags, built with Next 16.3.5 + Turbopack, measured by starter-route-js.mjs) plus 5%, rounded up. The starter now ships providers.scope 'groups', so the routes that load fewer bytes with it (/, /support, /docs, /blog) carry referenceGroupsGzipBytes, the same build measured with 'groups', and maxGzipBytes is that plus 5%: a ceiling from the 193 value would let the providers return to the root layout unnoticed (about 21 kB). Signed-out routes (public: true) must not carry any dashboardOnlyMarkers. How it was measured: scripts/performance/README.md.
